goal: Productionize segmented append authority with derived validated checkpoints, bounded compaction, reversible v1 migration, and resource-safe production qualification.
acceptance_criteria: one logical ProjectKnowledgePack authority is preserved
ordered authoritative segments are checksummed, chained, and atomically exposed
checkpoints and indexes remain validated rebuildable derived data
bounded compaction preserves raw history, provenance, hashes, and as-of semantics
legacy v1 remains readable and migration remains explicit, reversible, and non-dual-write
crash points C1 through C8 recover old or fully committed new state without silent corruption
production v2 must pass 100k and 250k scale, cold-start, workload, and crash benchmarks before default adoption

quality_metrics.measure: semantic, retrieval, Conversation, history, raw-byte, migration, and crash equivalence

improvement: rerun frozen production benchmark when a workspace and memory are both below 75 percent utilization

interface_expectations: ProjectKnowledgePack remains the sole logical authority
v2 storage is internal to persistence and transparent to Knowledge/Conversation semantics
new packs remain v1 by default until the adoption gate passes
v2 creation is explicit through format_version 2.0 or migration

feedback: Format v2, segment authority, checkpoint, compaction, crash injection, v1 compatibility, and 10-shape migration pass targeted validation.
The final source passes 2755 tests with zero failures or errors.
Formal production scaling was not started because memory and every available volume exceeded the explicit 75 percent safety threshold.
SHOULD_V2_BECOME_DEFAULT_FOR_NEW_PACKS = NO until 100k/250k production qualification passes.

worked: separating logical authority from physical segments and derived acceleration
controlled C1-C8 failure injection and semantic hash equality
retaining v1 default after adoption-gate review
did_not_work: the first source commit enabled v2 for new packs before the scale adoption gate
the first full regression exposed a missing benchmark marker
formal scale preflight could not pass on any available volume or current memory state
experiments: development-only 1k checkpoint interval and compaction threshold study
formal scale run intentionally not started
